BACKDOOR HQ // DEVELOPMENT PIPELINE

DEVELOPMENT ROADMAP

A transparent overview of ongoing development, planned features and concepts being evaluated for future releases.

ROADMAP
⌁
DEVELOPMENT STATUSUPCOMING DEPLOYMENTS
PREVIEW
IN DEVELOPMENTACTIVE WORK
◉
CORE GAME DEVELOPMENT & SYSTEM INTEGRATION

Backdoor HQ remains under active development. Recent work has focused on establishing a more cohesive headquarters experience, refining the building interface and navigation, and improving the presentation and consistency of the wider game environment.

Development has also progressed across the Alliance HQ and its building structure; crew progression and equipment; mission systems and automated mission assignments; and the Nano Command Deck, including scouting, attack and defence workflows, combat reporting and operational logs.

Supporting systems have been refined alongside these features, including player communications, account-specific progression and saves, VIP and shop interfaces, player rewards, system gifts and the consolidated update archive. These areas continue to be reviewed, tested and improved as development proceeds.

ONGOING
PLANNEDFUTURE DEVELOPMENT
◇
EXPANDED ALLIANCE FEATURES

Broader alliance functionality intended to strengthen cooperation, coordination and shared progression between members.

PLANNED
◇
ADDITIONAL MISSION TYPES

Introduce a wider variety of missions to provide more objectives, strategic choices and opportunities for crew deployment.

PLANNED
◇
WORLD MAP // SCOUTING & ATTACK OPERATIONS

Develop a world map that brings scouting and attacks together in one location. This is intended to move the current scouting workflow out of the Nano area and allow players to identify targets, scout locations and launch attacks directly from the world map.

PLANNED
◇
PLAYER-TO-PLAYER RESOURCE TRANSFERS

Introduce a secure way for players to send resources to other members, allowing alliance members to provide practical assistance when another player needs support.

PLANNED
◇
NANO DEFENCE // ALLIANCE REINFORCEMENTS

When a player is under attack, the Nano interface will provide an option to request reinforcements. Available alliance members will be able to send support to help defend the player's position and improve their chances of successfully repelling the attack.

PLANNED
UNDER CONSIDERATIONDESIGN & BALANCING REVIEW
⌕
REINFORCEMENT ACCESS & COST MODEL

The possibility of allowing players to spend Kill Tokens to request or strengthen reinforcement support is being evaluated. Access may also be linked to a qualifying VIP level. Any costs, VIP requirements, availability rules and limits will be assessed carefully to preserve fair play and avoid creating an excessive competitive advantage.

REVIEW
